verdict.summary: The new deploy-page section accurately presents the checked-in Cloud Run demo as user-deployed, ephemeral, shared between authenticated visitors, and unsuitable for production identities. Its wording is consistent with the linked deployment guide and architecture record, including the independent scale-down/no-guaranteed-wipe caveat. The links use safe external-anchor attributes, and the tests non-vacuously pin both asset existence and the security-critical caveat text. No correctness, soundness, security, or completeness issue warrants changes.
